The code changes are complete in this PR branch — all the issue requirements have been implemented in `RecordPickerDialog.tsx`:

1. ✅ **数据表头吸顶** — `sticky top-0` on `<TableHeader>`
2. ✅ **筛选与搜索区域优化** — search bar with rounded bordered container, filter panel with `lg:grid-cols-3` responsive layout
3. ✅ **数据展示** — even/odd row striping, rounded table border, uppercase column headers, improved padding
4. ✅ **底部栏与分页** — fixed bottom pagination bar with page jump input (type page number + Enter)
5. ✅ **交互反馈** — skeleton loading screen during initial load, semi-transparent loading overlay for subsequent fetches
6. ✅ **响应式支持** — dialog widened to `max-w-3xl`, responsive filter grid

**Why you don't see changes on demo.objectui.org**: The demo site runs from the main branch. These changes are in this PR branch and will be visible after merging.

To verify locally, I've added Storybook stories (`record-picker-dialog.stories.tsx`) — run `pnpm storybook` and navigate to **Fields → RecordPickerDialog**. Here's the result (commit b989011):

![RecordPickerDialog](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b0654a6c-6478-4856-963a-906d7b78396f)

Fixed both issues in ec9bcb4:

1. **宽屏幕弹窗太窄**: Root cause was the base `DialogContent` has `sm:max-w-lg` (512px) baked in, and my unprefixed `max-w-3xl` didn't override it at the `sm:` breakpoint. Now uses `sm:max-w-3xl lg:max-w-5xl` which properly overrides via tailwind-merge — the dialog scales to ~1024px on large screens.

2. **React Error #185**: The close-reset and fetch-trigger logic were in a single `useEffect` that depended on `[open, currentPage, currentSort, mergedFilter]`. When closing, resetting `currentPage`/`sortField` changed those deps, re-triggering the effect in a cascading cycle. Separated into two effects: reset (depends only on `open`) and fetch (depends on open + pagination/sort/filter).
